subtype_label: Focus internal / focus inference (no given focus)
query: Help me understand what's worth attention in these goal records.

judge.implied_focus: The strategic nature and business significance of each goal -- characterizing what each goal is trying to achieve (outcome domain, mechanism, materiality) so analysts can judge which goals are worth attention.

per_column.name: goal_outcome_domain
per_column.rationale: Classifies the business outcome the goal targets -- a core facet of what a goal is about.

per_column.name: improvement_mechanism
per_column.rationale: How the goal intends to drive change; a coherent 'lever' facet of the goal's strategic nature.

per_column.name: target_population_scope
per_column.rationale: Who/what the goal affects; a scope facet contributing to importance assessment.

per_column.name: quantified_target_direction_sign
per_column.rationale: Direction of the quantified target; a meaningful attribute of the goal's ambition.

per_column.name: temporal_scope
per_column.rationale: Time horizon of the goal; a relevant facet for prioritization.

per_column.name: outcome_metric_indicator
per_column.rationale: The metric used to measure success; ties directly to the outcome focus.

per_column.name: goal_confidence_completeness
per_column.rationale: Degenerate single-value (all true) flag conveying no discriminating information; noise.

per_column.name: baseline_specificity
per_column.rationale: Whether a baseline is specified; a quality/attention facet of the goal's rigor.

per_column.name: metric_goal_alignment_flag
per_column.rationale: Degenerate single-value (all false) flag; conveys nothing and does not aid focus.

per_column.name: enabling_capability_gap
per_column.rationale: What capability the goal depends on; a substantive facet for feasibility/attention.

per_column.name: outcome_materiality
per_column.rationale: Business materiality/risk of the outcome; central to 'what's worth attention'.

judge.rationale: The added columns collectively centre on characterizing each goal's strategic substance and significance -- outcome domain, mechanism, scope, metric, materiality, and feasibility/quality signals -- which coheres well around an inferable focus of 'what makes a goal worth attention.' This is not a scattered grab-bag; most facets are differentiated and data-inferable, giving a sound multi-facet analytical structure at a useful granularity. Actionability is high: an analyst could genuinely triage/prioritize goals by materiality, capability gap, and baseline rigor. It is not a perfect realization: two columns (goal_confidence_completeness=all true, metric_goal_alignment_flag=all false) are degenerate single-value fields that add no discriminating signal, and there is some overlap between goal_outcome_domain and outcome_materiality, mildly diluting the structure. Overall a strong, coherent focus inference with minor noise.
